# sngl:ui/markup under reactive structure builds and runs on fyne and gtk4.
#
# list.sngl: a reactive `if` gating an item of a markup list. Before
# passInstanceSlots it panicked irwalk on the *ir.SlotInst; after it, the item
# was a runtime instance whose task checkbox had the empty handler its override
# hands it, emitted as func() against fyne's func(bool).
#
# tasks.sngl: a task list over state, whose items are built in a render slot
# whose parameter shadowed fyne's container package.
#
# para.sngl: a reactive `if` among a paragraph's spans, which neither target has
# a container to render a slot into; the paragraph is the slot instead.

[!gtk4] skip 'gtk4 needs its development libraries to build'

sngl test --platform=fyne list.sngl
stdout 'ok'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 list.sngl
stdout 'ok'
sngl test --platform=fyne tasks.sngl
stdout 'ok'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 tasks.sngl
stdout 'ok'
sngl test --platform=fyne para.sngl
stdout 'ok'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 para.sngl
stdout 'ok'

-- list.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"
import md "sngl:ui/markup"

component main node {
    var shown = true

    vbox {
        md.list {
            md.listItem {
                text(value="one")
            }
            if shown {
                md.listItem(task=md.Task.todo) {
                    text(value="two")
                }
            }
        }
        button #flip(text="flip", @click { shown = !shown })
    }
}

func testFlip(t Test, c main) {
    c.flip.click()
    c.flip.click()
    t.assert(c.shown)
}

window {
    main
}
-- tasks.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"
import md "sngl:ui/markup"

component main node {
    var items = ["a"]

    vbox {
        md.list {
            for var it = items {
                md.listItem(task=md.Task.done) {
                    text(value=it)
                }
            }
        }
        button #more(text="more", @click { items.push("b") })
    }
}

func testMore(t Test, c main) {
    c.more.click()
    t.assert(c.items.length == 2)
}

window {
    main
}
-- para.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"
import md "sngl:ui/markup"

component main node {
    var loud = true

    vbox {
        md.paragraph {
            md.text(value="quiet ")
            if loud {
                md.bold {
                    md.text(value="LOUD")
                }
            }
            md.text(value=" end")
        }
        button #flip(text="flip", @click { loud = !loud })
    }
}

func testFlip(t Test, c main) {
    c.flip.click()
    t.assert(!c.loud)
}

window {
    main
}
